response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist software engineer with a strong track record across web, mobile, and backend systems, but his resume shows minimal direct experience with the core requirements of this GenAI role: no Python listed in his skill set, no mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation/observability, or major cloud AI platform design work, and only about a year of tangential exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators) in his current role. The 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required by the JD is not evidenced anywhere in his history.
strengths: 15+ years of progressively senior/staff-level software engineering experience across diverse domains
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery experience
Recent exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling in current role
concerns: No listed Python experience and no demonstrated production AI/GenAI system delivery over 8+ years as required
No evidence of RAG architecture, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability work
Limited major cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) AI-specific design experience; cloud usage is largely infrastructure/CDK for non-AI products

key_factors.factor: No RAG/vector database/LLM evaluation expertise shown
Strong general staff-level engineering and leadership background
